Re-reading a file with a different hash than recorded here means it changed after this freeze and CS004 Block 1+ must re-check for drift before relying on it.

cs004_config_object_fingerprints.fingerprinting_procedure: shasum -a 256 over the raw committed file bytes (UTF-8, LF line endings, as written by this session's Write tool). NOT the canonical-JSON/key-sorted procedure CS001 uses (src/tai_public_finance/primitives/parameters.py: canonical_json + sha256_of) -- that module does not exist on this branch (see FINDINGS.md, 'Fingerprinting procedure'). Recompute with plain shasum -a 256 to verify; do not expect these hashes to match a canonical-JSON hash of the same content.
